scope: GMM execution-component distillation, component matching, routing and nearest-mode supervision

sources.title: M2Distill: Multi-Modal Distillation for Lifelong Imitation Learning
sources.mechanism: 机器人 lifelong IL 中完整新旧 GMM 的 Monte Carlo KL 蒸馏。
sources.difference: 未见 teacher argmax Gaussian W2 与 nearest-component margin。
sources.code_status: official training code not verified in this review

sources.title: SPREAD: Subspace Representation Distillation for Lifelong Imitation Learning
sources.mechanism: 教师 GMM 采样中选最高密度 90% 动作做选择性蒸馏。
sources.difference: 动作密度筛选不等于整轨迹成功筛选。
sources.caveat: Equation 6 sign versus minimization prose requires implementation clarification; no correctness claim.
sources.code_status: official training code not verified in this review

sources.title: Learning Lane Graph Representations for Motion Forecasting
sources.mechanism: 选择 GT 距离最小模式，再用 margin 训练其置信度。
sources.difference: 预测轨迹，不是 Gaussian KD；回归最佳模式而非当前 argmax 执行模式。

sources.title: Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Optimizing Gaussian Mixture Policies
sources.mechanism: Gaussian W2 与 GMM 最优传输匹配用于机器人策略更新。
sources.difference: 无成功历史缓存与 SHBR 路由。

sources.title: Variational Distillation of Diffusion Policies into Mixture of Experts
sources.mechanism: 将 diffusion teacher 蒸馏为 Gaussian mixture experts 并优化 gating。
sources.difference: 非 continual success-history distillation，变分目标也不同。
sources.code_status: official repo identity verified; algorithm assessment from paper

sources.title: Principled Fast and Meta Knowledge Learners for Continual Reinforcement Learning
sources.mechanism: 旧状态缓冲与 Gaussian W2 用于持续 RL 的策略知识整合。
sources.difference: 非 GMM 最近分量 hinge 路由。
sources.code_status: official repo identity verified; algorithm assessment from paper

sources.title: Behavior Transformers: Cloning k modes with one stone
sources.mechanism: 机器人模仿学习的最近动作 bin 分类监督和残差预测。
sources.difference: 固定 bins，非动态 Gaussian teacher matching。

sources.title: MoFlow: One-Step Flow Matching for Human Trajectory Forecasting via Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation based Distillation
sources.mechanism: 教师多模态轨迹集与候选学生集匹配蒸馏。
sources.difference: 人轨迹预测，无执行 Gaussian margin 保持。

sources.title: Revisiting Distribution Matching for State-to-Vision Policy Distillation in Laparoscopic Robotic Manipulation
sources.mechanism: 机器人连续 Gaussian 策略蒸馏比较 W2、KL 等距离。

sources.title: Teacher-Student MixIT for Unsupervised and Semi-Supervised Speech Separation
sources.mechanism: 跨领域教师输出到学生的 permutation-invariant 匹配蒸馏。
sources.difference: 语音源分离，不是机器人策略；仅限定置换不变性源流。
